data.title: Jury begins deliberations in Tupac Shakur murder trial
data.description: LAS VEGAS - A jury began deliberations on Monday in the trial of a former Los Angeles gang leader accused of involvement in the sensational murder three decades ago of chart-topping rapper Tupac Shakur.

data.title: 22 reservoirs overflow in heavy rains
data.description: <p>Authorities have warned of heavy to very heavy rain across upper Thailand through tomorrow, raising the risk of flash floods and forest runoff.</p>

data.title: Ukraine wants winter aid as war drags on
data.description: <p>Ukraine has urged Thailand to provide more humanitarian aid ahead of winter, while calling for greater Thai involvement in reconstruction and efforts to return Ukrainian children taken during the war.</p>

data.title: Court tells Sarana to hear verdict
data.description: <p>The Central Administrative Court has summoned Dr Sarana Boonbaichaiyapruck, the chair of the National Broadcasting and Telecommunications Commission (NBTC), to hear its ruling on Wednesday on his qualifications.</p>

data.title: Bulbul breeding rules ease
data.description: <p>Natural Resources and Environment Minister Suchart Chomklin has signed a regulation removing the red-whiskered bulbul (nok krong hua juk) from the protected wildlife list.</p>

data.title: Police in Huai Khwang target 'grey capital' gangs
data.description: <p>Huai Khwang police have launched a sweeping crackdown on high-risk entertainment venues, illegal workers and suspected nominee businesses as part of a campaign to restore confidence in the district and combat grey-capital networks.</p>

data.title: Data centre growth sparks health fears
data.description: <p>A rapid expansion of the data centre industry could pose health and environmental risks to nearby communities, an expert has warned.</p>

data.title: Krok E-Dok waterfall shut for two days
data.description: <p>SARABURI: Khao Yai National Park closed Krok E-Dok waterfall in Kaeng Khoi district from Monday to Tuesday after heavy upstream rain caused flash floods and strong currents.</p>

data.title: Thais roar into Olympic history
data.description: <p>Thailand stunned Asian volleyball powerhouse China in Tianjin on Sunday night, coming from behind to win 3-2 in the final and qualify for the Olympic Games in women's volleyball for the first time.</p>

data.title: Psychological support prepared as school resumes classes after shooting incident
data.description: Debsirin Nonthaburi School has prepared to provide psychological support for up to one year after it resumes on-site classes on Tuesday following a tragic shooting incident on Aug 7.

data.title: Tribunal says India cannot withdraw from water treaty with Pakistan
data.description: THE HAGUE - An international tribunal ordered India on Monday to "observe its obligations" under a treaty with Pakistan on the sharing of the Indus and other rivers, which the New Delhi government sought to suspend.

data.title: Thai volleyballers return triumphantly ahead of Asian Games
data.description: Players and staff of the Thai women’s volleyball team arrived at Suvarnabhumi airport in Samut Prakan on Monday night, where fans gathered to welcome them home after their crucial victory secured a place at the 2028 Olympic Games.

data.title: Southern shortcut bridges get go-ahead
data.description: Plans have been put into motion by the government to build two major bridges in the nation's southern region with an aim to improve transport connectivity, support tourism and stimulate local economic activity.

data.title: Japan's oldest person, 115-year-old woman from Nara Prefecture, dies
data.description: KYODO — Japan's oldest person, Shigeko Kagawa, a 115-year-old resident of Nara Prefecture, western Japan, died late last week, the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare reported on Monday.

data.title: Swollen rivers, washed-out roads hamper Nepal rescue effort
data.description: BIDUR (NEPAL) - Nepali rescue teams battled difficult terrain, an unpredictable river and treacherous marshland on Monday, the sixth day in their search for survivors and victims of devastating floods.

data.title: Cambodia says no online scam compounds remain, experts sceptical
data.description: ​The Cambodian government has claimed a milestone ‌in its fight against the scam industry accused of stealing billions of dollars from victims around the world, with officials saying they have eradicated all scam compounds in the country.
